lang.name: English
app.title: Install {edition}
welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.lead: This installs {edition} on this computer. It takes about 10 minutes, and you only need to click Next.
welcome.keyboard.test: Type here to test your keyboard
edition.title: What do you want to install?
edition.lead: Pick one. The one this USB drive started is already selected.
edition.switch.title: Start the other image
edition.switch.text: {edition} installs from its own start-up entry. Restart the computer and choose “{edition}” in the menu that appears.
net.title: Network
net.lead: Connecting to the network. The installation also works without one.
net.lanonly: Connected to the local network, but not to the internet
net.offline.help: That is fine: the installation needs nothing from the internet. You can connect later.
machine.title: Your computer
machine.layout.mirror: The {n} disks will keep identical copies: if one fails, nothing is lost.
machine.layout.raidz1: The {n} disks will be combined; any one of them can fail without losing data.
machine.layout.raidz2: The {n} disks will be combined; any two of them can fail without losing data.
machine.everything: Everything on {them} will be deleted. Other disks are not touched.
machine.refused.title: This computer is not supported
machine.refused.text: It does not meet what {edition} needs:
machine.lab.help: For test machines and virtual machines only. Things may not work.
machine.lab.on: Lab mode: the minimum requirements are waived.
machine.nodisk: No disk can be used for the installation.
erase.title: Erase and install?
erase.text: This deletes everything on {disk}. This cannot be undone.
account.title: Name and administrator
account.lead: The administrator can change everything on this computer. Remember the password.
account.hostname.help: How this computer appears on the network. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
account.password.keep: Leave empty to keep the password you already chose.
account.ssh.help: Paste a public key (it starts with ssh-ed25519 or ssh-rsa) to sign in over the network.
account.passphrase.help: Only for a medium that carries encrypted packages. Leave empty to add them later.
recovery.title: Your recovery key
recovery.lead: Your disk is encrypted. This computer asks for this key when it starts. Write it down, or save it to a USB drive, and keep it somewhere safe.
recovery.warn: Without this key, nothing on the disk can be read. It is shown only now.
recovery.lost: The installer restarted, so here is a new key. The old one was never used.
recovery.written: I have written it down or saved it
recovery.qr: Or scan it with a phone
install.title: Installing
install.lead: This takes a few minutes. Do not turn the computer off.
install.failed.title: The installation stopped
install.failed.text: Something went wrong while “{step}”. Nothing else was changed on other disks.
done.title: Installation complete
done.text: {edition} is installed. Remove the USB drive, then restart the computer.
fb.title: Setting up {edition}
fb.lead: This computer is getting ready. It takes a few minutes the first time.
fb.detail.offline: No network. Everything still works on this computer; connect it later.
fb.detail.unsynced: Not synchronised: the clock keeps the computer's own time.
fb.detail.default-deny: On: only SSH is let in
fb.detail.starting: Starting (this can take a few minutes)
fb.hook.failed.help: You can try again. If it keeps failing, the log is at /var/log/runink/firstboot.d/{name}.log.
fb.page.skip.help: It comes back the next time this computer starts.
fb.page.refused: A setup page was not shown: {why}
fb.ready.title: Your {edition} is ready
fb.ready.name: Name
fb.ready.fingerprints.help: Check that your SSH client shows one of these the first time it connects.
fb.finished: Setup is complete. You can sign in on this screen or over SSH.
err.state: That cannot be done right now. The screen has been refreshed.
err.request: The installer did not understand that request.
err.internal: Something went wrong inside the installer.
err.role: Choose what this computer will be.
err.net.failed: The network setup did not finish.
err.wifi.scan: Could not look for Wi-Fi networks.
err.wifi.connect: Could not connect. Check the password and try again.
err.wifi.psk: A Wi-Fi password has 8 to 63 characters.
err.erase.word: Type the word exactly as shown.
err.erase.disks: The disks changed. Look at the screen again.
err.account.missing: Fill in the name and administrator first.
err.hostname.invalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes (not at the start or end).
err.username.invalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _, starting with a letter.
err.username.reserved: That name is used by the system. Choose another.
err.password.invalid: That password contains characters that cannot be typed at start-up.
err.sshkey.invalid: That does not look like an SSH public key.
err.passphrase.required: This medium carries its models encrypted: enter the medium passphrase to install them.
err.recovery.ack: Tick the box once you have written the key down.
err.usb.list: Could not list the USB drives.
err.usb.device: That drive is not available any more.
err.usb.write: Could not write to the USB drive.
err.install.resolve: The disks changed since you confirmed them. Nothing was written.
err.install.env: The installer could not prepare the steps.
err.install.prepare: The installer could not clean up the previous attempt.
err.firstboot.retry: Could not start the setup steps again.
interrupted: The installer was restarted while installing.
